title: Nine Hundred Yen
topic: A child buys flowers for a mother's birthday and accuses the shop of giving the wrong change.

title: The White Cat
topic: A man living alone starts feeding a white cat in his garden, then learns whose cat it really is.

title: The Wrong Classroom
topic: A new girl walks into the wrong room on her first morning, and the boy who laughs at her walks her to the right one.

title: The Cup I Broke
topic: A broke student's first job interview at a coffee shop goes wrong in the loudest possible way.

title: The Typhoon Inn
topic: Two friends heading to the beach get stopped by a typhoon and end up somewhere better.

title: Mike's Window
topic: A woman promises to look after her hospitalized neighbour's cat, and the cat immediately escapes.

title: The Message I Never Opened
topic: A student works out why her best friend has gone cold on her, and it turns out to be her own fault.

title: The Old Notebook
topic: A salesman is offered the branch he has waited fifteen years for, and asks for something else instead.

title: The Violin Upstairs
topic: A woman new to Nagoya complains about the noise from the flat above, then meets the child making it.

title: The Extra Zero
topic: A junior employee mistypes an order quantity, hides it for a weekend, and learns that the delay was the real mistake.

title: Sunday Morning, the Car
topic: A daughter in Tokyo tries to make her seventy-eight-year-old mother stop driving, and loses the argument until her mother loses it for her.

title: Forty Years of Paper
topic: A print shop owner is pushed out of his building, refuses his son's money, and closes on his own terms.

title: Fifteen Seconds
topic: A wry essay on the strict choreography of the Japanese corporate apology.

title: The Light at the Pass
topic: A reporter visits a dying mountain village where one vending machine is still kept lit.

title: My Mother's Brother
topic: A son lets himself be mistaken for his mother's long-dead brother, week after week.
